title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.31789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executions. We introduce Phronix, a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions. Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities. It distills every observed interaction into a capability store and researches a failing task rather than abandoning it. F

translated_title: Phronix：面向智能体的以能力为中心的学习范式
translated_abstract: 科学计算日益依赖基于大语言模型的智能体来执行性能工程任务，例如插桩、分析和工作流移植。然而，智能体的效能很大程度上取决于其所处的运行框架（harness），而这些框架通常依赖人工编写的技能和人工整理的记忆。这限制了智能体的自主学习能力，迫使智能体反复重新探索解决方案，而不是保留并复用先前执行中获得的知识。我们提出了Phronix，这是一种以能力为中心的学习范式，使智能体框架能够从自身的执行中获取、验证并完善可复用的能力。Phronix通过预测器-验证器-纠正器循环运行：MCP工具及相关技能提出解决方案，工具执行过程对其进行验证，观察到的结果则用于完善所存储的能力。它将每一次观察到的交互提炼到能力库中，并对失败的任务进行深入研究而非直接放弃。
tldr: 提出Phronix，一种以能力为中心的智能体学习范式，通过预测-验证-纠正循环让智能体从自身执行中自主获取、验证并完善可复用的能力，摆脱对人工编写技能和记忆的依赖，并将失败任务转化为研究机会。
en_tdlr: Phronix introduces a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to autonomously acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions through a predictor-validator-corrector loop, freeing agents from reliance on manually written skills and curated memory while turning failing tasks into research opportunities.
